heading_path: Linguistics and Psychology Combined Major Credit Requirement

entries.text: Complete 72 semester hours in the major (excluding supporting courses).

overview_text: This combined major is designed to educate students in psychology, linguistics, and the interface between the two disciplines, which are core areas within the field of cognitive science. Students study the formal structures of human language; sociocultural aspects of language use; and the cognitive aspects of language representations, language acquisition, and language processing. Students receive interdisciplinary training in the methods of experimental psychology, psycholinguistics, and linguistic analysis.
